description: This Java source file defines an abstract actor class for streaming data in an Akka-based system. It handles commands to start streams, creates sources, and manages message batching with associated timeouts.

classes.name: AbstractStreamingActor
classes.description: An abstract Akka actor class that manages streaming commands, creates data sources based on commands, and batches messages for streaming.

methods.name: getCommandClass
methods.description: Abstract method to specify the command class type.

methods.name: getBurst
methods.description: Abstract method to determine the number of elements to stream per batch based on the command.

methods.name: getInitialTimeout
methods.description: Abstract method to get the initial timeout duration for the stream.

methods.name: getIdleTimeout
methods.description: Abstract method to get the idle timeout duration for the stream.

methods.name: createSource
methods.description: Abstract method to create a Source of elements based on the command.

methods.name: batchMessages
methods.description: Batches a list of elements into a single message, choosing the single element if only one is present.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines message handling, primarily to start streaming on receiving a command.
